Text.Text: I'm Corporal Mira Tannis, and I scout the south for the garrison. The Dantari lived here long before the colony did, and lately they have been reminding us. I could use your help.
Here is your scout's pay. I take no pleasure in this, and I don't think you did either. When you're ready, ask me why the hunters keep coming.
You're back. There have been no ambushes south of the trail for four days. Did you kill all ten Dantari Hunters?

The South Fields belonged to the Dantari, and the colony ploughed half of them under. Now Dantari Hunters ambush anyone who goes south of the trail. I need you to go into the South Fields and kill ten Dantari Hunters. If they lose that many, they may treat the trail as a border. Come back to me when it's done.
Good. Kill ten Dantari Hunters in the South Fields on Dantooine, then come back to me here.
The colony sent them gifts once, and the Dantari sent every one back unopened. Nobody has tried again since, so for now the garrison holds the trail by force.
You still need to kill ten Dantari Hunters in the South Fields on Dantooine. Come back to me when it is done.
That should hold for a while. Here is your pay, which is the only form of thanks the garrison has.
You're back. The Dantari are on the ridge again, and this time they are only watching. Did you kill all five Dantari Shamans?

Their shamans send them. A hunter on his own will watch you and leave, but a hunter with a shaman behind him attacks. I need you to go back into the South Fields and kill five Dantari Shamans. Without them, the hunters should go back to watching. Come and tell me when all five are dead.
Good. Kill five Dantari Shamans in the South Fields on Dantooine, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill five Dantari Shamans in the South Fields on Dantooine. Come back to me when it is done.
The Dantari Shamans who send them, but deal with the hunters first. Finish killing the Dantari Hunters in the South Fields, then come back and ask me again.
Here is the patrol rate. The order still stands, so come back whenever you want to walk it again.
You came back, so it must have gone well. Did you finish the patrol and kill twenty Dantari Hunters?

There is a standing order for it. I would walk the patrol myself, but there is only one of me and a lot of ground to cover. Go into the South Fields and kill twenty Dantari Hunters, then come back to me here on the Field Trail. You draw the patrol rate every time you do it.
Good. Kill twenty Dantari Hunters in the South Fields on Dantooine, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill twenty Dantari Hunters in the South Fields on Dantooine. Come back to me when it is done.
Thank you. A scout's route is worth more than the pay, but the pay is what I can give you.
You're back. I walked the Janta Caves end to end last night and marked every turn. Did you kill eight Voritor Lizards and eight Gizka?

I need a safe route through the Janta Caves, and right now they are packed with Voritor Lizards and the Gizka they feed on. I need you to go into the caves and kill eight Voritor Lizards and eight Gizka. Once they are thinned out I can mark a path. Come back to me when it's done.
Good. Kill eight Voritor Lizards and eight Gizka in the Janta Caves on Dantooine, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill eight Voritor Lizards and eight Gizka in the Janta Caves on Dantooine. Come back to me when it is done.
The garrison posted a bounty on that animal and nobody would take it. You earned it, so it is yours.
You're back, and the river is running again at the crossing. Did you kill the Mutated Ice Bol?

A Bol, but not a farm Bol. Something changed this one. It is white, twice the normal size, and I watched it freeze a river crossing solid. I need you to kill the Mutated Ice Bol. It roams the Abandoned Warehouse, the Canyon River and the Canyon Crystal Caves, and it is not always there, so keep checking. Come back to me when it is dead.
Good. Kill the Mutated Ice Bol in the Abandoned Warehouse, the Canyon River or the Canyon Crystal Caves on Dantooine, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill the Mutated Ice Bol in the Abandoned Warehouse, the Canyon River or the Canyon Crystal Caves on Dantooine. Come back to me when it is done.
I would not have believed it if the canyon weren't so quiet. Here is the bounty, all of it.
You're back, and the Thune have come down into the canyon again because nothing is hunting them. Did you kill the Graul?

A Graul. I have only seen its tracks, and the tracks were enough. It kills Thune for sport. I need you to find the Graul and kill it. It roams the Abandoned Warehouse, the Canyon River and the Canyon Crystal Caves, and it is not always there, so you may have to look more than once. Come back to me when it is dead.
Good. Kill the Graul in the Abandoned Warehouse, the Canyon River or the Canyon Crystal Caves on Dantooine, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill the Graul in the Abandoned Warehouse, the Canyon River or the Canyon Crystal Caves on Dantooine. Come back to me when it is done.
Goodbye, Corporal. Stay low out there.
What other work do you have in the south?
Yes, all ten Dantari Hunters are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. Ten Dantari Hunters in the South Fields.
No, it's their land. I won't do it.
Has anyone tried to make peace with the Dantari?
What are the Dantari doing to the colony?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Dantari Hunters.
Yes, all five Dantari Shamans are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take it. I'll kill five Dantari Shamans.
No, I won't kill their elders.
Why do the Dantari Hunters keep coming?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Dantari Shamans.
What comes after the Dantari Hunters?
Yes, I killed all twenty Dantari Hunters.
I will come back.
On my way.
Yes, I'll patrol the South Fields for you.
Not this time, Corporal.
Is there patrol work in the South Fields?
Still working on it.
Remind me what the South Fields patrol involves.
Yes, eight Voritor Lizards and eight Gizka are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. Eight Voritor Lizards and eight Gizka.
No, you should find another route.
What do you need done in the Janta Caves?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Voritor Lizards.
Yes, the Mutated Ice Bol is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll hunt down and kill the Mutated Ice Bol.
No, I'll keep my distance from it.
What is the worst thing you have seen out there?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Mutated Ice Bol.
Yes, the Graul is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll hunt the Graul and kill it.
No, its tracks are close enough for me.
Is anything out there bigger than the Bol?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Graul.
